podcast.body: He wrote and sang this song, which became a number three hit on the Billboard Hot 100 for Jefferson Starship's album *Red Octopus*. He stipulated that the band record this song as a condition for his permanent return to the lineup. "when he was pressed about coming back on a more permanent basis he said he would if they would agree to record this."
